description: Live E2E for the GridMap RQL module. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py (scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (adapter, validation, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its adapter description). The 'tools' then run every GridMapGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-backs and two rejected values (a dry-run set, and a call that must fail before it changes anything). res://e2e-meshlib.tres is the testbed's empty MeshLibrary fixture (GridMap does not check item ids against the library). 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated.

input.query: nodes | where name == "Grid" | set MeshLibrary = "res://e2e-meshlib.tres", CellSize = "(1, 1, 1)"
nodes | where name == "Grid" | get cells | select x y z item orientation
nodes | where $ is GridMap | select name cellCount MeshLibrary
nodes | where name == "Grid" | select cellCount CellSize.x CellOctantSize

expect: CellSize must be at least 0.001 on every axis
orientation must be an orthogonal orientation index from 0 to 23
